name: pg_aggregates_try_parallelize_array
subject: Don't try to parallelize array_agg() on an anonymous record type.
goal:
A parallel aggregate can fail when array_agg collects rows of an anonymous composite type. With parallel workers disabled the query succeeds, but enabling a parallel plan can make it report `input of anonymous composite types is not implemented` instead of returning the same array.

Create a table suitable for parallel scanning and compare `array_agg(s)` over a row-valued subquery with `max_parallel_workers_per_gather` set to zero and to a positive value. Both executions must return the same value without error. Parallel aggregation of supported scalar and named composite types must remain available, and ordinary array_agg results must not change.
